errors.text_span: Die niedrigsten Werte sind 0 Mio. Euro Entlastung in der Kategorie 0–<20 und 20 Mio. Euro Belastung in der Kategorie ≥200.
errors.evidence: The description misattributes the values to the wrong categories. In the 0–<20 category, the value for 'Entlastung' (relieved) is 1,070, while the value for 'Belastung' (burdened) is 0. In the ≥200 category, the value for 'Entlastung' is 20, while the value for 'Belastung' is 720. The sentence swaps the series for both values mentioned.
The legend is located at the bottom center of the chart, not on the bottom left.
